text:
I tried to make your book swap poster, but Magic Hour turned the job down. Your account has 0 credits left, and this poster needs about 10. Nothing was made and no credits were used.

The plan was a tall (9:16) poster with:
- A big "BOOK SWAP" headline and the line "Bring a book, take a book!"
- Colourful flat drawings of book stacks and people trading books
- Mustard, teal, coral and cream colours
- Blank space at the bottom for your event details

To make it, add credits to your Magic Hour account (or wait for your free credits to refill), then tell me to go ahead. If you send me the date, time, place and any wording you want, I can put that on the poster too.
Background colour? Your call on that one only. Keep the exact wording, black lettering and no pictures.
